<<Airing Out A Boathouse, Briefly>>

THE BOATHOUSE WAS A HUB OF ACTIVITY FOR THE NEIGHBORHOOD, BUT IT WAS TIME FOR A BREAK. THE NEIGHBORS TOGETHER WORKED TO AIR OUT THE BOATHOUSE, REMOVING ALL FURNISHINGS AND CLEANING EVERY CORNER. THEY USED A LARGE FAN TO HELP DISLIEVE THE AIR, AND THEY WERE CAREFUL NOT TO DAMAGE THE WOODEN STRUCTURE. AFTER A DAY OF WORK, THE BOATHOUSE WAS READY FOR USE AGAIN, AND THE NEIGHBORS TOGGLED A SIGN TO INDICATE IT WAS CLEAN AND READY. THIS SIMPLE ACT SHOWED THE POWER OF TOGETHERSHIP AND THE VALUE OF A CLEAN ENVIRONMENT FOR ALL.
